summary: The visible suite now passes (3 passed). I changed only `solution/core.py`. The cause was operand order in `run()`. The binary-op branch did `a, b = pop(), pop()`, which bound `a` to the top of the stack, the right-hand operand. So SUB, DIV, MOD, LT and GT all computed right-minus-left or right-compared-to-left. That made `1 < 2` evaluate to 0, let `DIV`/`MOD` check the wrong operand for zero, and broke the countdown loop's `SUB`, so it never reached zero and hit the step limit. I changed the pop to `b, a = pop(), pop()` so `a` is the left operand. I also fixed `SWAP`, which had the same ordering mistake and was effectively a no-op; it now pushes the top value first, so the two values actually swap. I did not touch `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the public API. I did not run the hidden suite, so the fix is verified only against the visible tests.
